reason: network is not solved: the energy balance needs dispatch results (p time series) from an optimisation or power flow run; none are present
assumptions: Sign convention (PyPSA statistics.energy_balance): positive = energy supplied to a bus, negative = energy withdrawn from a bus (loads, storage charging, branch withdrawal at a port). Every branch port is counted at its own bus, so with no carrier filter the sum over all rows of a bus carrier is the nodal balance and must be ~0 per snapshot.
Energy (MWh) = sum over snapshots of power (MW) x snapshot_weightings.generators (h).

Only bus carriers whose buses use unit 'MW' or an energy label 'MWh*' (PyPSA-Eur: MWh_el, MWh_LHV, MWh_th; flows in MW) are reported, each with its raw `unit`; other units (e.g. t_co2) and mixed-unit carriers are listed in excluded_bus_carriers.
